g.text: # Rule types verified against AWS's DQDL parser on 2026-09-23: https://github.com/awslabs/dqdl
# A generated ruleset is a starting point derived from one profile of one file. Review it
# before committing it to a pipeline: the tool describes the data it was shown, which is not
# the same as the data you expect tomorrow.
# 500 rows in the file, allowing 20% either way at balanced strictness
# all 500 values distinct and non-null, so this looks like a key
# observed 100000 to 100499, widened by 5% at balanced strictness
